reason: A context-management plugin that summarizes exploration after a checkpoint and replaces the model-visible span with the report while retaining the full session log.

summaries.zh: 在检查点之后将探索过程自动总结为报告，并用报告替换模型可见上下文，同时保留完整会话日志。
summaries.en: Summarizes exploration after a checkpoint into a report and replaces the model-visible context while preserving the complete session log.

capabilities: Summarizes exploration history through the configured language model
Replaces the model-visible context after a checkpoint while retaining the full durable log
Provides a model-facing rewind tool and turn guard
